subject: Marketplace listing: hero asset, pricing tiers & legal clarifications
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@horizon-analytics.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Marketplace listing: hero asset, pricing tiers & legal clarifications

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — Horizon is excited to get the listing live. Before we submit the offer to AWS, the marketplace team flagged three items they need resolved:

1) Hero image: they want a 16:9 hero (minimum 1200px wide) and separate ALT text. Can you confirm the final asset and caption?
2) Pricing clarity: for our private offers we need a clear per-seat vs. flat-rate breakdown and a visible footnote about minimum commit. Can we provide the pricing tiers spreadsheet in the requested template?
3) Legal/product description: the legal team asked for an explicit data residency statement (US-only) and a short paragraph on audit logging (SOC2 evidence will be attached later).

Timeline: AWS would like the updates by EOD Monday (4/5) to make this week’s marketplace ingestion window. Is that feasible?

Attachments: Horizon-procurement-request.pdf (their PO template)

Cheers,
Sarah
Procurement Lead, Horizon Analytics

[Attachment: Horizon-procurement-request.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@horizon-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: hero asset, pricing tiers & legal clarifications

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list. We can meet the 4/5 ingestion window, aiming to submit by EOD Monday. I’m looping in Marissa for product copy + hero alt text, Karthik for the legal/data residency blurb and SKU/AMI guidance, and Ben for pricing grid alignment.

Action items we’ll deliver by Monday:
- Final hero (PNG + ALT) and 3 size variants [Marissa]
- Pricing tiers in AWS template (per-seat vs flat, minimum commit footnote) [Ben]
- Legal/data residency & logging paragraph + SOC2 note [Karthik]  
- Filled seller registration form for Horizon (I’ll attach once signed) [Olga]

Cc’ing AWS PM once we have the assets to confirm ingestion requirements.

Olga Petrov
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood_hero_v3.png (image/png)]

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Marketplace deliverables for Horizon (timeline + ownership)

Team — quick plan so we can hit AWS ingestion by Monday: 

Marissa: please produce 16:9 hero + 4:3 and thumbnail. Need ALT text (<= 125 chars), 1-line elevator (<= 120 chars) and 3 short bullets (benefit-focused) suitable for the marketplace listing. Avoid platform claims like "fastest" without benchmarks.

Ben: align the pricing spreadsheet to AWS schema. Horizon expects per-seat annual + a flat-rate enterprise option. Add a clear footnote: "Minimum annual commitment applies; contact sales for custom quotes." Put unit prices in USD and a monthly equivalent column.

Karthik: short legal blurb for product description around data residency (US only) and audit logging. Also confirm whether this listing should be SaaS subscription (no AMI) or bring-your-own AMI. Horizon is SaaS, so likely SaaS; mention that no customer-managed AMI is required.

I’ll prepare the seller registration form and the DocuSign flow. Ben — can you pull the sample private-offer footnote text AWS prefers?

Olga

[Attachment: pricing_tiers_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 11:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Marketplace deliverables for Horizon (timeline + ownership)

Thanks — mock copy below (first pass). I’ll upload images to Drive and tag them.

1-line elevator:
Redwood Inference — predictable, cost-optimized LLM inference for production apps.

3 bullets (marketplace):
• Predictable latency and autoscaling for steady workloads.
• Cost controls: batching, caching, and quantization profiles to lower per-token unit costs.
• Enterprise-grade controls: VPC options, KMS integrations, and audit logs.

ALT text for hero_v3.png:
"Redwood dashboard visual showing model throughput graph and cost-breakdown widget"

Notes: avoid the words "SLA" in the public blurb; use "SLA-backed options available" in the advanced details section. Also flagged an accessibility alt text tweak (included).

Marissa
Director, Product Marketing

> On Apr 2, 2027, at 09:15, olga_petrov@redwood.com wrote:
> 
> Team — quick plan so we can hit AWS ingestion by Monday: 
> 
> Marissa: please produce 16:9 hero + 4:3 and thumbnail. Need ALT text (<= 125 chars), 1-line elevator (<= 120 chars) and 3 short bullets (benefit-focused) suitable for the marketplace listing. Avoid platform claims like "fastest" without benchmarks.

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 07:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Marketplace deliverables for Horizon (timeline + ownership)

Quick legal/product notes: 

- Data residency: "Data processed and stored in the US region. Customers requiring alternative residency should contact sales for on-prem or private deployment options." Keep it short and non-committal until the legal team signs off.
- Audit logging: "Supports customer-accessible audit logs and integrates with common SIEMs; SOC2 Type II report available upon request."
- SKU/AMI: since Horizon is SaaS, mark the listing as SaaS subscription (no AMI). SKU naming: use REDWOOD-SUBSCRIPTION-<tier> (avoid special chars).
- Private offer footnote example (per AWS): "Private offer pricing applies to committed terms; see private offer schedule for minimums and billing cadence." Ask Ben to confirm exact phrasing.

I’ll run this by legal Monday AM for final sign-off.

Karthik
Head of Product Compliance

> On Apr 3, 2027, at 11:38, marissa_cole@redwood.com wrote:
> 
> Thanks — mock copy below (first pass). I’ll upload images to Drive and tag them.

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@horizon-analytics.com>, AWS Marketplace PM <pm@amazon.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: hero asset, pricing tiers & legal clarifications

Hi Sarah — quick status update and attached deliverables for AWS ingestion: 

1) Visuals: hero_v3 (16:9), 4:3 crop, thumbnail uploaded to Drive -> https://drive.google.com/redwood/aws-listing-visuals. ALT text included as requested.
2) Pricing: attached pricing_tiers_v2.xlsx with per-seat annual, flat-rate enterprise option, and a minimum-commit footnote.
3) Legal/product blurb: added data residency (US only) and audit-logging language; see the product description section in the drive doc. Karthik will get legal sign-off first thing Tuesday if AWS needs binding language for the listing.
4) Seller registration: attached seller_registration_form_filled.pdf — please confirm Horizon signs and returns.

Next steps we propose:
- AWS ingestion submission by our team once Horizon confirms the seller form (expected Tue 4/6).
- Marissa to follow up if marketplace requires any alternate asset sizes.

Sarah — can you confirm Horizon can sign the seller form tomorrow morning? If yes, we’ll queue the ingestion for Tue.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference

[Attachments: redwood_hero_v3.png (image/png), pricing_tiers_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), seller_registration_form_filled.pdf (application/pdf)]
